task_card.title: A shared before/after CompareWidget for Flow results - declared, not per-flow code

next_action.description: Build OPTION B. In MpiBaseFlow's result pane, replace the bare `<video controls>` for video results with MpiVideoViewer + MpiVideoControlBar, and make the declared compare surface a toggle on top of it. REUSE - the architecture already supports this: MpiVideoViewer's own header says the control bar is deliberately NOT owned by the viewer so other surfaces can reuse it, and MpiGroupHistoryBlock.js:416 wires the pair in two lines. Keep `showTrim: true` (the seek bar IS MpiTrimBar; Fabio confirmed the in/out handles riding along is fine). Ask Fabio before widening scope further, and decide with him whether this stays on MPI-585 or becomes its own card.

key_decisions: The compare engine was NOT rebuilt. ComparisonManager + MpiCanvas activeMode 'compare' already did the reveal bar, the dual-video RAF sync and every image/video pairing; what was duplicated-in-waiting was the transport living inside MpiCompareOverlay, and that is what got lifted into MpiCompareView.

OPTION B is Fabio's pick over A (player only when no compare) and C (an adapter so the control bar also drives the compare pair). C stays a possible follow-up - it needs a shim from the bar's surface contract (_play/seek/frameStep/getVideoElement) onto MpiCanvas's playCompare/frameStepCompare, and it touches a shared Compound.

The control bar already has everything asked for: play, frame back/forward, current/duration time, the seek track with playhead, loop, mute + volume slider, fullscreen, and a time-vs-frames toggle. `showTrim: false` exists but REMOVES THE SEEK BAR TOO (MpiTrimBar is track + in/out handles + playhead in one) - so keep it true.

Scope, per Fabio 2026-08-20: upscale video, head swap AND the character sheet get a comparison. ltx-extend and ltx-foley deliberately do NOT (an extend's output is longer than its source; foley returns the same pixels), and a test pins those omissions so a later sweep has to argue with it.

The character sheet Flow is being built in ANOTHER session, so it was not edited here. The declaration contract went to it as an mpi-message (6ce69667-...), including the caution that a sheet generated from scratch may deserve no comparison at all.
No dev gallery entry for MpiCompareView - Fabio explicitly waived the components.md rule-4 ask.
